claims: Cricket features two teams of 11 players each.
Cricket involves defending wooden targets called wickets.
Cricket is played on an oval field with a central pitch.
One team bats to score runs while the other bowls and fields to restrict scoring and get batters out.
Cricket formats include Test, One-Day (ODI), and T20.
Objective of cricket is to score more runs than the opposing team.
Teams have 11 players per side.
Two batters are on the field at a time.
All 11 fielders are on the field.
Batters score single runs by running between wickets.
Hitting the ball to the boundary scores 4 runs if it touches the ground.
Hitting the ball to the boundary scores 6 runs if it clears the boundary.
Bowled dismissal occurs by hitting the wickets with the ball.
Caught dismissal occurs by catching a hit ball before it touches the ground.
Run out dismissal occurs by hitting the wickets before a runner crosses the line.
LBW dismissal occurs by trapping a leg in front of the wicket.
An over consists of six legal deliveries.
An innings ends when 10 batters are out.
An innings ends when all allotted overs are completed.
Test Cricket is played over five days.
Test Cricket is traditionally played with red balls.
Test Cricket is traditionally played with white clothing.
Each team plays 50 overs in ODI.
ODI is commonly played with white balls.
ODI is commonly played with colored clothing.
Each team bats for 20 overs in T20 Cricket.
Wicket-keeper stands behind the wicket to catch balls missed by the batter.
Wicket consists of three wooden stumps plus bails.
Boundary is the perimeter of the field.
Crease is the white lines marking the batting and bowling areas.
Cricket 24 is a real-time sports simulation title.
Cricket 26 is a real-time sports simulation title.
Cricket Director is a management simulation game.
